rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MRC Data delivers verified supply chain intelligence for the Chinese apparel industry. The database covers suppliers across 31 provinces with 63+ dimensions per record, fabric specifications with independent lab measurements (AATCC, ISO, GB standards), and industrial cluster comparisons. Supports supplier discovery, fabric sourcing, OEM/ODM matching, and compliance certification lookup. Available via MCP protocol and REST API with a free tier of 100 requests per day.
